operations.title: Nima sends Benincasa the bounded weight-five exactness ladder
operations.body: Event 1290 freezes the first exactness ladder. With D=product of the 25 fiber-dependent marked norms and A_j=(1/2)∂_j log(prod_i R_i), test primitives η with components p_j/D, deg p_j≤d. Each modular column is D^-1(∂_j m - m∂_j log D + A_j m); target is the event-1283 black-box f_12345. Run d=0,1,2,3 (3,12,30,60 unknowns), two primes, generic-support rejection, held-out verification. Failure is only a bounded common-simple-denominator exclusion. This avoids expanding P_sat and is ready to graft onto either reducer.
